content.title: How to Watch WrestleMania 42 Night 2 Live Tonight: Start Times, Streaming Info, Match Card
content.text: Key PointsWrestleMania 42 spans two nights, featuring top WWE stars and major championship matches.The main cards will air on Saturday, April 18, and Sunday, April 19, starting at 6 p.m. ET.Streaming options, start times broken down by time zones, and the full match cards are detailed below. Updated April 19, 2026: WrestleMania 42 Night 1 happened last night and featured the return of Paige, who teamed with Brie Bella to win the WWE Women’s Tag Team Championships. It also saw Cody Rhodes retain his Undisputed WWE Champtionship against Randy Orton, Liv Morgan win the Women’s World Championship from Stephanie Vaquer, and Becky Lynch defeat AJ Lee for her WWE Women’s Intercontinental Championship. WrestleMania 42 Night 2 airs live tonight and will see CM Punk defend his World Heavyweight Championship against Roman Reigns, Rhea Ripley battle to win Jade Cargill’s WWE Women’s Championship, and Sami Zayn put the WWE United States Championship on the line against Trick Williams. One of the most anticipated matches of the whole weekend will also see the incredibly strong Oba Femi face Brock Lesnar. This guide breaks down all of the matches fans can expect, along with everything you need to know about watching Night 2, including streaming options and start times. When Is WrestleMania 42? Exact Dates and Start Times by Time Zone WrestleMania Night 1 and Night 2 take place on Saturday, April 18, and Sunday, April 19. Each night will be preceded by a three-hour Pre-Show that will start at 3 p.m. ET/12 p.m. PT, followed by the main card, which starts at 6 p.m. ET/3 p.m. PT each night. Here are the start times for both nights of the main card in other common time zones: United States: Eastern Time (ET): 6:00 p.m. Central Time (CT): 5:00 p.m. Mountain Time (MT): 4:00 p.m. Pacific Time (PT): 3:00 p.m. Alaska Time (AKT): 2:00 p.m. Hawaii-Aleutian Time (HAT): 1:00 p.m. Canada: Pacific Time (PT): 3:00 p.m. Mountain Time (MT): 4:00 p.m. Central Time (CT): 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time (ET): 6:00 p.m. Atlantic Time (AT): 7:00 p.m. Newfoundland Time (NT): 7:30 p.m. International: Greenwich Mean Time (GMT/UTC, e.g. London): 11:00 p.m. Central European Time (CET, e.g. Milan): 12:00 a.m. the next day Eastern European Time (EET, e.g. Helsinki): 1:00 a.m. the next day Moscow Standard Time (MSK): 2:00 a.m. the next day Gulf Standard Time (GST, e.g. Dubai): 3:00 a.m. the next day India Standard Time (IST): 4:30 a.m. the next day China Standard Time (CST, Beijing): 6:00 a.m. the next day Japan Standard Time (JST, Tokyo): 7:00 a.m. the next day Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST, Sydney): 8:00 a.m. the next day New Zealand Daylight Time (NZDT, Auckland): 10:00 a.m. the next day Men's Journal NewslettersWe'll keep you in the know on the hottest new gear, whiskey releases, TV shows and movies, and deals everyone's talking about.or sign in withBy signing up I agree to the Terms of Use and acknowledge that I have read the Privacy Policy. You may unsubscribe from email communication at anytime. Right after each night’s main card, the WrestleMania Post-Show will start and feature appearances from Chief Content Officer Paul “Triple H” Levesque and various WWE superstars. For people in Las Vegas during Night 2, there is an official WrestleMania 42 afterparty that fans can attend that is hosted by Rob Gronkowski. It will be held at Marquee Dayclub at The Cosmopolitan of Las Vegas starting at 10:30 p.m with Tiffany Stratton, Trick Williams, and Lash Legend all set to appear. Tickets are still on sale. How to Watch WrestleMania 42: Streaming Options and TV Details The WWE’s website states that in the United States, WrestleMania 42 Night 1 and Night 2 will air live on ESPN (via the ESPN app for those with an Unlimited subscription) and on Netflix in most international markets. On Saturday and Sunday, the Countdowns will be available on ESPN, WWE.com, and WWE social channels, while the Post-Show will be available on the same platforms except WWE.com. WrestleMania 42 Full Match Card for Night 1 and Night 2 Since WrestleMania is the biggest event in wrestling, the card is always stacked, and this year is no different. Both nights of the event will have several championships on the line, fierce grudges will come to a head, and captivating superstars will perform. Night 1 is set to be headlined by a match that is years in the making when Cody Rhodes takes on Randy Orton. Night 2 will see CM Punk put his World Heavyweight Championship on the line against Roman Reigns after they have been trading sharp and very personal verbal jabs for weeks. The 2026 event took place on late Friday night/early Saturday morning (April 17 at 9 p.m. PT / midnight ET on April 18). In the United States, the full replay is now available on the ESPN app for subscribers to ESPN Unlimited. Internationally, the ceremony was streamed on WWE’s YouTube channel, where the full replay or highlights can now be watched in several markets. If available in your country, the full replay can be seen under the Live section of the WWE’s YouTube channel.
